answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by binding voting power to locked capital rather than mere node count. In this lotus-like architecture, an attacker must acquire significant native tokens, an investment equivalent to high-value timber, to command a terrace of influence. This economic hurdle renders identity fabrication prohibitively expensive, as the cost to acquire stake exceeds the potential gains from manipulating the network, effectively securing agent autonomy.
